scripts.push-migrations: node bin/with-env.js supabase db push && pnpm generate-types
scripts.reset-remote-database: node bin/with-env.js supabase db reset --linked && pnpm generate-types && pnpm seed-buckets
scripts.generate-types: node bin/with-env.js sh -c 'supabase gen types --linked > src/database.types.ts' && pnpm build
scripts.start-local-stack: node bin/with-env.js sh -c 'supabase start && supabase status -o env > ../../.env.supabase' && pnpm seed-buckets:local
scripts.reset-local-database: node bin/with-env.js --local sh -c 'supabase db reset && supabase gen types --local > src/database.types.ts' && pnpm build && pnpm seed-buckets:local
scripts.generate-types:local: node bin/with-env.js --local sh -c 'supabase gen types --local > src/database.types.ts' && pnpm build
